page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-highmem-384-lssd is a memory-optimized server instance belonging to the c4d server family. It features 384 dedicated vCPUs built on the x86_64 CPU architecture. The system is equipped with 3024.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 7.88 GB of RAM per core.

For storage, the instance includes 32 local NVMe SSDs, though the exact aggregate storage capacity is not specified in the hardware profile. There are no GPUs integrated into this configuration, as the GPU count is zero. The instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, this instance represents a high-density resource profile designed for enterprise-scale workloads that require massive memory capacity alongside high-core compute capabilities. The combination of 384 dedicated vCPUs, substantial memory, and local NVMe SSD storage makes this server type suitable for large-scale databases, in-memory analytics, memory-intensive enterprise applications, and heavy data processing workloads.
